text: SEC EDGAR enforces its fair-access policy: a User-Agent carrying a repo URL gets a flat 403, the same request with a contact email returns 200. EDGAR is therefore gated on settings.sec_enabled() (STOCKY_SEC_CONTACT) and skips itself when unset.

Bing News RSS answers a multi-term OR query with an EMPTY feed where Google News returns a full one. Bing needs a single quoted phrase plus 'stock' (services/news/bing_news.build_query); it cannot share google_news.build_query.

GDELT rejected as a news source: phrase search too loose ("shell" returns awards shows and retirement advice), legal suffix absent from body copy so the precise form finds nothing, ~20s TLS handshake and 429 at 1 req/5s. Cost more latency than all other sources combined for articles the relevance filter dropped. Bing covers the non-US reach instead.

Nasdaq's per-ticker RSS (www.nasdaq.com/feed/rssoutbound?symbol=X) returns GENERIC market news for unknown symbols rather than an empty feed - same trap as Yahoo's symbol-keyed endpoints. Keep NASDAQ out of dedup._RELATED_ALLOWED.

Nasdaq quote API splits a quote into primaryData (trading now, extended hours after the bell) and secondaryData (regular close). Use the regular-session block whenever present, else an after-hours print gets stored as the day's close. Also refuse suffixed symbols - SHEL.L would return the NY ADR.
